versions.line: Claudopus no longer sends the chat a message of its own when a task hands in a part of its result
The Leaderboard tab shows the board as a table with headings, the first three places in gold
Join on the leaderboard answers at once
The Leaderboard tab has three switches once you've joined
A link to your own leaderboard page now always previews as your card, with your name, figures and picture
Joining the leaderboard now says, one short line each, what the board shows, what is never sent
The panel's Leaderboard button now opens a Leaderboard tab
A link to someone's leaderboard page now shows a picture of their stats wherever you paste it
A leaderboard on claudopus.ai
Release it is the only press a release needs
The website's home page says the same things in about a third of the words
When a task hands you a part of its result, the task itself now tells the chat
The website's home page now opens with what you get
When a task asks you for a key, the box to paste it into is on its card at once, with the task's question
The Claudopus tab always stays first in the panel's row of tabs
A task's Details now shows what it does as it happens, at the end of its conversation
A task can now hand you a report on a part that is finished while it goes on with the rest
When a task's result asks you something, your answer in words, or a message you send the task
The button at the right end of the line above the prompt now follows the panel
An Open panel button now sits at the right end of the memory, processor and graphics line above the prompt
Each time the Claudopus panel closes, Claudopus's log now says who closed it
A task that hands in its result but still asks you something, such as whether to release
A task's Details lists the messages you sent it above its Message box, numbered in the order you sent them
Results opens again with many results
When you press Message on a card right after typing in its Details box
On Linux, stopping a command a task runs now ends everything that command started, not only its first shell
A task's Details tab with a lot in it, such as many helpers and ended commands
A cloud job that sends nothing back is no longer called idle
Once you answer a permission in words, its buttons go and the card shows one grey line of your words while…
A Claude artifact a task or its helpers publish shows first on the task's card
